budget_items.topic: MA DEP Recycling Dividends Program award

budget_items.quote: program and this year was awarded $7,200.

budget_items.topic: Retail prices of rain barrels, compost bins and kitchen compost buckets sold at DPW
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager gave the resale prices for rain barrels, compost bins, the combined set, and kitchen compost buckets.
budget_items.quote: rain barrels can be purchased for $56, compost bins for $43, or together they can be purchased for $80, and the kitchen compost buckets are $5.

budget_items.topic: MassDOT project funding for Netflix-related scouting follow-up
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A project or projects are to be submitted to MassDOT for up to $400,000 in construction costs; this will be a future agenda item.
budget_items.quote: the next step is to work on a project or projects to submit to massdot for up to $400,000 in construction project costs.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The risk management grant covers safety training, safety equipment and property loss items up to a grant award of $10,000.
budget_items.quote: risk management grant program that covers safety training costs, safety equipment, and property loss items up to a grant award of $10,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Police Chief submitted an application for $8,900 for EVOC training, and the Town Manager is looking for other items to reach the $10,000 maximum.
budget_items.quote: chief marino has submitted an application for $8,900 for emergency vehicle operation

budget_items.topic: Lunenburg Water District garage/office project funding
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Water District will appropriate money for the new garage/office funded by USDA money, paid from the current operating budget and cellular tower revenues, without raising water rates; no dollar figures were printed.
budget_items.quote: this project will be funded using usda money, which requires the funding for the entire estimated costs to be allocated prior to going to bid.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A comprehensive storm water management plan will help determine the cost of the MS4 permit work; no dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: a comprehensive storm water management plan will help determine the cost of doing so.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Planning Board's approach to a moratorium extension would not add costs; no dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: would not incur additional costs or confusion holding a special election
